name: LinksTrackly
author: linkstrackly

sections.description:
LinksTrackly allows you to create custom short links, manage redirects, and track clicks directly inside WordPress.

It is a simplified WordPress edition of the LinksTrackly routing system, designed for marketers, affiliate users, and campaign managers who need fast and reliable redirection.

With this plugin, you can:

  • Create custom unique link codes
  • Redirect using 301, 302 or cloaked mode
  • Track clicks with device detection
  • Store click data with unique detection
  • Export click reports to CSV
  • Use basic traffic routing logic
  • Manage multiple destination URLs (Pro feature)

This plugin is ideal for:

  • Affiliate marketers
  • Performance marketers
  • Bloggers
  • Small businesses running campaigns
  • Anyone needing a simple redirect + tracking system inside WordPress

For advanced routing features such as geo targeting, device-based redirects, fraud detection, VPN blocking, postbacks, and advanced analytics, upgrade to the full LinksTrackly platform.

Upgrade to Pro

The full LinksTrackly platform includes:

  • Advanced traffic filtration (Bot / VPN / Proxy detection)
  • Geo-based redirect (Country / Region)
  • Device-based routing
  • Weighted rotator
  • Fraud detection & risk scoring
  • Postbacks (S2S)
  • Detailed reporting & analytics
  • Campaign cost tracking
  • Priority updates & support

Visit the LinksTrackly website to learn more.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or upload the ZIP file via WordPress Admin.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to LinksTrackly in the admin sidebar.
  4. Create your first tracking link.
sections.faq:
1. Do I need a third-party service to use Linkstrackly?
    No. Unlike other link shorteners, Linkstrackly works directly on your WordPress site using your own domain.

2, Is there a limit to how many links I can create?
No. You can create and manage as many unique links as your business requires.

  1. How do I track my link performance?
    Linkstrackly includes a built-in stats package that tracks unique and total clicks. For more detail, you can integrate it with Google Analytics.

  2. Will this plugin slow down my website?
    Linkstrackly is designed to be lightweight. It focuses on executing specific redirect tasks efficiently to maintain your blog’s performance.

  3. Does the plugin support affiliate links?
    Yes! It is specifically designed to help affiliate marketers manage and beautify long, complex affiliate URLs.

  4. Is Linkstrackly GDPR compliant?
    The plugin allows you to manage how data is tracked, helping you maintain compliance while gathering necessary insights.

  5. Can I customize the redirect behavior?
    Yes. You can choose different redirect types and, with the Pro version, utilize geographic or cloaked redirects.

screenshots.caption: Link Configuration: Users enter the target URL and create a custom slug (e.g., "my-product") to generate a clean, branded link.
Redirect Management: A simple dropdown menu allows users to select the redirect status (301, 302, or 307) for each link.
Reporting Dashboard: The plugin displays a visual summary of link hits, including total clicks and unique visitors over a specific timeframe.
